01 · roadmap topology

Dependency and route graph

Click a stage to inspect its public evidence and mapped work. Keyboard focus is supported on every node.

Roadmap stages are arranged by layer. Solid blue edges are source-backed dependencies, green dashed edges are editorial roadmap routes, and violet dotted edges are conceptual suggestions without a claim of proved Lean dependency.

Reading the graph: a route is a navigation aid assembled from public roadmap statements, PR stage tags, and explicit evidence notes. It does not assign a summit, completion score, or proof obligation to the project.
